parole.significato: emperor (the monarch of an empire; the title of this monarch), especially the German or Austrian kaiser
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old High German keisar (“emperor”), itself a borrowing from Latin Caesar.

parole.significato: stork (large bird with long neck and legs and a long straight beak; fam. Ciconiidae)
